title: Inefficient ACL checks repeated per item
summary: Extension code repeats authorization checks individually across large item lists.
rationale: Repeated ACL logic can add CPU/database overhead and slow list pages.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Batch permission checks where safe, precompute effective access, and avoid repeated service construction.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
